reasoning: Analysis from the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI) confirms that Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption (frequently estimated between 120 TWh and 160 TWh in recent years) exceeds the total annual electricity consumption of entire countries, including Argentina (which consumes approximately 125 TWh annually). This comparison has been widely reported by reputable news outlets such as the BBC, citing data from Cambridge University.
